Proof#

This page points at PROCTOR's proof runs against real Wayne State applications, and how the docs site and the test suite are built and run. To read a report once you have one, start with Formats.

Proof runs#

Proof runs against real Wayne State applications are on a private site, proof.apps.wayne.edu/proctor, behind a Wayne State employee sign-in.

Docs#

The documentation lives at proctor.apps.wayne.edu/docs and is built from docs/ by Squire's docs builder:

composer docs

renders the pages into site/docs/ and fills the generated command and environment reference from the CLI and the source. The pages are committed, so the site stays static. Check without writing:

composer docs:check

which runs as part of composer ci.

Running the tests in Docker#

Maintainers: how to build, test and release this project, and where its data comes from, is in MAINTAINING.md.

No PHP is needed on the host:

docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/app" -w /app composer:2 composer install --no-interaction
docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/app" -w /app php:8.4-cli vendor/bin/phpunit

The same works with php:8.3-cli in place of php:8.4-cli.

Strongly recommended: a git.wayne.edu instance runner.
